profile.name: Look Up
profile.description: Watches the night sky over your home and only messages you when something is worth stepping outside for: the space station, Starlink trains, bright planets, meteor showers, eclipses, comets, and aurora. It checks the clouds first and tells you exactly where to look.

skills.name: look-up-events
skills.description: Use when a Look Up user asks about comets ("any comets?"), eclipses ("next eclipse?", "will I see the eclipse?"), meteor showers ("when are the Perseids?", "best time for the Geminids?"), or what their binoculars or telescope can show tonight. Also the reference for viewing-gear limits. Comets come from MPC orbital elements, and there's a 2026-2030 eclipse table with local visibility.

skills.name: look-up-getting-started
skills.description: Use FIRST on any message (even "hi", a question, or a photo) when Look Up isn't set up yet, meaning /workspace/look-up/config.json is missing, has no home, or onboarded is false. Also use for "set me up" or "start over". Starts onboarding on its own, with no setup command needed. Steps: a sky photo for location (installs the engine in the background), a real "From your yard tonight" preview, three tap-to-answer widgets (what to watch, viewing gear, outside hours), then the routines and tonight's sky map.

skills.name: look-up-highlight
skills.description: Use when a Look Up user asks "what's the best thing to see this week?", "anything big coming up?", or "what should I not miss?". It also powers the "Your first big one" line that ends every onboarding and home-reset preview. It picks the single best sight in the next 7 to 14 days by a wow ranking, checks the weather, and returns the one-shot reminder for it.

skills.name: look-up-home
skills.description: Use when a Look Up user permanently changes their home sky: "reset my location", "new home", "I moved", "we moved to <place>", or a new photo sent with "this is my new spot". Also use for "show settings" and "where am I set to?". Replaces home, re-checks obstructions, reschedules the routines if the time zone changed, and confirms with a fresh tonight preview. Travel is separate (look-up-settings).

skills.name: look-up-live
skills.description: Use when a Look Up routine fires (the daily sky check, a "Look Up one-shot" reminder or look-now, or the nightly moon note), or when the user asks "anything tonight?", "what's up tonight?", "remind me", or "when's the next ISS pass?". Computes tonight's sky for their location and viewing gear (passes, moon, planets, meteors, aurora, bright comets, eclipses, daytime moon and Venus), labels each moment daytime/twilight/night, stays quiet when it's cloudy or nothing's worth it, sends at most one heads-up, and schedules short-lived reminders.
